messages:
talia: quick sync  we need a benchmark narrative for launch that ties latency to unit economics but doesn't read like a price list. two visual directions + tight hero copy options.

ben: drop raw $s in hero. i'll return a normalized index (Redwood = 1.0) and a p95 inset so we can speak to tail risk. paste mock numbers and i'll run it.

talia: mock numbers for comps (toy):
```
model,median_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k,tokens_per_$
Redwood-Prod,105,230,0.11,9090
EdgeLite,240,820,0.04,25000
QuantEdge,160,310,0.07,14285
```

indra: visual options: A) horizontal "tokens per $" bars (hero) with small p95 sparkline per bar; B) latency vs cost scatter with quadrants and a highlighted "sweet spot". A is clean for landing; B for methodology deep-dive.

chris: agree with A as hero. enterprise buyers care about p95/p99 so call that out in the subhead: "including tail latency (p95)". avoid absolutes like "cheapest" unless appendix supports.

tess: inbound routing: two CTAs. Devs: "Start in 5 mins" (self-serve trial + quickstart). Platform & infra: "Request architecture review" (form + AE). Webinar CTA: "See our methodology + results" (signup). ensure downloads tag lead source.

ben: i'll produce an indexed PNG + downloadable CSV and a one-paragraph methodology note: "Synthetic service workload; batching & KV cache enabled; see appendix for raw traces." will add % deltas vs Redwood in tooltips.

talia: hero copy options (A/B): "Predictable token economics for production" or "Lower $/token with tighter tail latency". which should be primary?

indra: A for landing (signals control), B for webinar promo (punchier).

chris: for the blog/deep-dive title try: "Measuring inference economics: latency, tails, and what matters in production". include a heatmap inset showing probability of >500ms under peak load.

tess: ad microcopy (short): "Reduce inference spend. Keep latency predictable." CTA: "Save my spot" (webinar) or "Start free" (PLG).

asset-bot: Asset task created: https://app.shortcut.com/redwood-inference/story/bench-1763459999 (assignees: ben, indra, tess, chris)

talia: action items: ben -> indexed chart PNG + CSV + p95 inset (Thu EOD); indra -> hero + deep-dive mockups + tooltip copy (Fri AM); tess -> CTA variants + routing rules (Fri); chris -> one-paragraph methodology + heatmap numbers. reconvene Mon standup to pick hero. thanks :sparkles:
